# Floating UI vendored distribution

- @floating-ui/dom 1.8.0 and @floating-ui/core 1.8.0 (UMD production builds).
- License: MIT, copyright 2021-present Floating UI contributors; see LICENSE.
- Upstream: https://github.com/floating-ui/floating-ui
- Retrieved 2026-09-18 from the exact npm release through jsDelivr; no runtime CDN/network dependency.
- These official UMD bundles inline @floating-ui/utils helpers; no third runtime script required.
- Update both pinned builds together, retain LICENSE, update entry/server paths and rerun tests/popup-webkit.js.
